entities.summary: Konrad Krajewski is a Polish Catholic prelate who was named Metropolitan Archbishop of Łódź in March 2026. He served as prefect of the Dicastery for the Service of Charity from 2013 to 2026. He served as Papal Master of Ceremonies from 1998 to 2013.
